title: baccharis ulicina var. multifida
intro: Baccharis ulicina var. multifida, commonly known as "Til" or "Tulsi" in some regions, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system, thereby offering relief from various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Baccharis ulicina var. multifida are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, and serve as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
